    CHAPTER I

The clerk copied the figure into his ledger and marked it with a
§ symbol, which nobody in the office could afterwards explain.

He used the same § symbol again upon the following page, and then
abandoned it altogether for the remainder of the volume.

A more ordinary line of prose, with commas, periods, and dashes,
should raise no complaint from the character frequency check.

The letters of the alphabet occur here many times over, and so
they are far too common to be reported as rare characters.
